sweep.protocol: STR pairs: clean row + corrupted row (other prompt of the pair) per directed case; spawns parent = corrupted, clean = clean
sweep.command: python scripts/ext7_wino_sweep.py --model qwen2_57b --pairs data/dial/pairs_e1_a2e_qwen2_57b.parquet --case-sets data/dial/case_sets_e1_a2e_qwen2_57b.json --out p6_e1_a2e_qwen2_57b --agent p6-data --max-rows 15000

joint.command: python scripts/ext7_wino_joint.py --model qwen2_57b --pairs data/dial/pairs_e1_a2e_qwen2_57b.parquet --case-sets data/dial/case_sets_e1_a2e_qwen2_57b.json --out p6_e1_a2e_qwen2_57b --agent p6-data --families main --max-rows 11250

joint_shared.command: python scripts/ext14_scan_joint_shared.py --model qwen2_57b --pairs data/dial/pairs_e1_a2e_qwen2_57b.parquet --case-sets data/dial/case_sets_e1_a2e_qwen2_57b.json --out p6_e1_a2e_qwen2_57b --agent p6-data --families main --max-rows 11250
